title: Tranche calendar and initiative-hooking for private tenancy quarterly plan
creator: Marcus Chen
description:
Problem: customers adopting isolated/private tenancy require predictable activation windows and a clear mapping from roadmap initiatives to OKRs and runbook tasks. Without a tranche calendar and an 'initiative-hook' interface, engineering and solutions teams spend cycles on ad-hoc scheduling, causing missed SLAs and customer frustration.

Objective: deliver a quarter-aligned tranche calendar + initiative-hooking mechanism in Console that surfaces activation windows, cohort gating, and explicit OKR mapping for Private/VPC/on-prem deliveries. The feature should enable PMs to publish tranche-level dates, link initiatives to OKR lines, and create exportable runbooks for onboarding/ops.

Scope: UI + backend schedule model, import/export (CSV + Confluence template), integration with rollout gates (canary/burst policies), and telemetry hooks for activation success/failure. Excludes billing contract changes and tenant-level legal signoff flows (handled separately).
acceptance_criteria: Console UI shows tranche calendar with at least 3 tranche slots per quarter
Each tranche can be linked to one or more initiatives and to a primary OKR line
Exportable runbook (Confluence template + CSV) generated from the tranche card
Telemetry event emitted on activation start/complete/failure (dashboardable)
Rollout gate integration: canary/rollback steps configurable per tranche
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal ops + 1 lighthouse customer (2 weeks)
Observe telemetry for activation success and customer feedback (1 week)
GA: enabled by default with opt-out for early tenants
risks: Legal/contract gating may delay activation windows for some tenants
Telemetry gaps in early rollout could hide regressions in activation logic
Backend schedule conflicts with existing upgrade windows for private fleets
tradeoffs: Ship v1 with CSV/Confluence export instead of deep RBAC for tranche edits (accelerates delivery)
Favor visible tranche UI over granular per-tenant scheduling in v1 (simpler UX for PMs)
Delay billing changes to avoid coupling release to commercial terms
